description: Create an Email Routing rule (forward an address to a destination). Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is active. Default true.

forward_to.description: Verified destination address to forward matched mail to.

match_to.description: Source address to match, e.g. hello@example.com.

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: create_email_rule
